wa_northwest_face_arete_in_the_sky.notes: CLEAN-UP CANDIDATE, VARIATION: not its own line. MP's Charted Waters page (wa_charted_waters, stored 9 pitches) says the left side of the P5 slab and arete above Moss Island (the top of Charted Waters P4) is called Arete in the Sky; Charted Waters P5 is 5.11c/d, 17 m. MP's Arete page starts it from Moss Island, gives it a temporary name and says more pitches are being developed. So it is a left-hand variant of Charted Waters P5, reached only by climbing Charted Waters P1-P4. Only MP lists it (not on theCrag's sector). Recommend merging into wa_charted_waters or keeping it flagged as a variation; owner decides. Only access/permit proposed. Stored sport (MP: Sport), length_m 15 (MP 50 ft) and pitches 1 (not stated) agree with MP. FA: MP gives Mark Deffenbaugh and Topher Dabrowski, May 14, 2024, but a photo caption on the same page says 05-16-2024; self-contradicting, not filled. Bolts and anchor not stated.
